user.title: Connect to Google Keep
user.description: Enter the Google account email and master token to use for syncing. We strongly recommend creating a dedicated Google account for this and sharing your Keep lists with it, rather than using your primary account, since the master token grants full access to that account.

lists.title: Choose lists to sync
lists.description: Select which Google Keep lists should be synced as Home Assistant to-do lists.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Google Keep
reauth_confirm.description: The master token for {email} is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_auth: Unable to authenticate. Double-check the email and master token.
error.no_lists: No lists were found on this Google Keep account.
error.no_lists_selected: Select at least one list to sync.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log for details.
